# `gen.strands`: Strands

Grows hair, fur, eyebrows, beards or grass on an object's surface as alpha cards, stylized clumps or fur shells, from about ten parameters.

- Category: gen
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(guides x segments x log F) to grow, plus O(F) for the region and coverage
- Flags: undoable, creates_groups, creates_objects
- Also known as: hair, fur, grass, beard, eyebrows, hair cards, particle hair, hair curves, groom

Strands are described, not drawn. Pick a `kind` (its preset sets everything), a `region` (the whole surface, face groups, or a loop of landmarks such as `["hairline_front", "temple_l", "nape", "temple_r"]`), and change what differs: `style` (`swept_back`, `parted`, `spiky`, `straight`, `combed`, `upright`, `wind_blown`, `ponytail` with an `anchor`), `length`, `clumps`, `gravity`, `curl`, `volume`. Strands are pushed out of the surface at every step, so they never penetrate it. `cards` come with a scalp cap, inner to outer layers and flyaways, UVs into a 4-column hair atlas (v from root to tip); `clumps` are closed tapered tubes; `shells` are offset copies for fur. The summary reports coverage and the largest bald spot; the full report stays on the object as metadata `strands`. The object is a child of `on`, tagged `strands`.

**Use for** hair, eyebrows, beards, fur, grass patches and other strand details.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `anchor` | `PointParam \| null` | - | Where a `ponytail` gathers (a landmark or coordinates). |
| `cap` | `boolean \| null` | - | A scalp cap under the cards. |
| `clumps` | `number \| null` | - | Guides: one card or clump each per layer (1 to 4096). |
| `curl` | `number \| null` | - | Waviness (0 straight to 1 tight curls). |
| `curl_turns` | `number \| null` | - | Curl turns along the length (0 to 20). |
| `flow` | `[number, number, number] \| null` | - | Direction for `combed` (the flow) and `wind_blown` (the wind). |
| `flyaways` | `number \| null` | - | Thin flyaway cards as a share of the guides (0 to 1). |
| `gravity` | `number \| null` | - | Droop toward -Y along the length (0 to 1). |
| `inside` | `PointParam \| null` | - | A point inside a loop's patch when it is not the smaller side. |
| `kind` | `KindParam` | `"hair"` | Preset: `hair` (cards, swept back), `fur` (shells), `eyebrows` (cards combed outward), `beard` (clumps hanging) or `grass` (upright cards). |
| `layers` | `number \| null` | - | Card layers, inner to outer (1 to 3). |
| `length` | `Length \| null` | - | Strand length along the curve. |
| `length_variation` | `number \| null` | - | Random shortening as a share of the length (0 to 0.95). |
| `lift` | `Length \| null` | - | Distance off the surface at the root. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | - | Object name; the kind is used when omitted. |
| `noise` | `number \| null` | - | Random direction changes (0 to 1). |
| `on` | `string` | required | The object the strands grow on (name, path or id); they become its child. |
| `output` | `OutputParam \| null` | - | What strands become: `cards`, `clumps` or `shells`. |
| `outward` | `boolean \| null` | - | For `combed`: mirror the flow's x away from x = 0 on both sides. |
| `part` | `Length \| null` | - | Where the part line is for `parted` (x; 0 is the center). |
| `region` | `RegionParam` | - | `"all"`, `{"groups": [...]}` face groups, or a loop of points around the patch such as `["hairline_front", "temple_l", "nape", "temple_r"]` (vertex groups, `lm.<name>` landmarks by name, or coordinates in the object's space). |
| `segments` | `number \| null` | - | Steps along each strand (2 to 64). |
| `shells` | `number \| null` | - | Offset copies for `shells` (1 to 32). |
| `sides` | `number \| null` | - | Points around a clump (3 to 16). |
| `style` | `StyleParam \| null` | - | Which way strands run: `swept_back`, `parted`, `spiky`, `straight`, `combed`, `upright`, `wind_blown` or `ponytail`. |
| `tip_width` | `number \| null` | - | Tip width as a share of the root width (0 to 1). |
| `volume` | `Length \| null` | - | Extra distance off the surface toward the tips (hair volume). |
| `width` | `Length \| null` | - | Root width of a card or clump; sized from the spacing when omitted. |

## Examples

```json
{"kind":"grass","on":"crate","region":{"groups":["top"]}}
```

Result: `created crate/grass (o:4) grass 0.6366 x 0.2489 x 0.6495 m: 480 faces (960 tris; budget 6,000); 120 cards, 960 tris, region 3600 cm2, coverage 98%`
